# Classify address-book drag data before generic attachment flavors

An address-book drag contains address text and can also contain flavors that look like an attachment. Entry 884 checks text/x-moz-address before getValidAttachments during drop and excludes it during dragover. A drop outside the body calls DropRecipient and prevents default text insertion; a drop into the body returns so default editor handling can proceed. DropRecipient resolves the address row from the target or data-address-row, rejects missing and raw rows, and creates recipient pills through the existing helper, which updates labels and recipient state. Manual helper and routing proposal: keep address side effects outside the attachment-returning helper, preserve flavor priority and name the actual recipient row. getValidAttachments still changes gIsValidInline, so this is not a claim that it is a pure function. Drag/drop source checks do not establish keyboard or screen-reader behavior.

Scope: compose-address-drag-routing.
